name: mandateguard
description: A permission-aware AI purchasing agent. AI proposes purchases but never authorizes them. A quarantined LLM extractor and a deterministic policy engine block prompt-injected or out-of-mandate buys, and PayPal Checkout plus server-side verification handle approval and capture. Built for the PayPal AI Hackathon

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web "npm start" "npm --prefix web run dev"
